fusions.name: Felled Across Them
fusions.desc: Cuts a trunk loose so that it falls along a narrow line 5 tiles ahead of you. It deals 14 damage to everything under it and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: The Last Notch
fusions.desc: A felling cut that deals 22 damage and leaves the target 25% easier to wound for 8 seconds. It deals 15% more damage for each of your afflictions on the target (max 45%). Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Coppice Shoots
fusions.desc: New shoots close over your cuts and restore 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Living Haft
fusions.desc: Conjures a blade on a living haft. It increases your weapon damage by 12% and your maximum health by 12, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
